subject: Correct the TESSERA b28 card on class 28
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-17 to correct the model card now. release/hf/imint-tessera-b28/README.md says class 28 follows NMD 2023's stand-level code 113 and so has stand boundaries; nothing in the repository supports the stand-level claim. What is true (scripts/relabel_barrblandskog.py): forest classes 1-4 in the training labels are the NFI-trained distillation head's per-pixel calls, while class 28 is NMD 2023 code 113's own extent laid over them. The card must say that, and say that a version with a five-forest-class distillation will replace this one. Then export a new release from main with scripts/hf_release.py (same checkpoint im023/tessera_b28/best_model.pt, weights unchanged), upload it to RISE-Sweden/imint-tessera-b28 as a new revision on Tobias's go (given 2026-11-17: 'rätta modellkortet nu också'), and add its RELEASES.md row in a follow-up PR. Not in scope: retraining, the five-class distillation itself, Prithvi, metrics (results private until the paper). Review: fresh single-model Claude reviewer (Codex out until 2026-11-18); integration is Tobias's decision.
